label: PF Backlog 144
title: BUG: 0a must write its canonical artifact artifacts/0a/discovery-output.md (+ .html/.xlsx)
body:
Stage 0a (core/pipeline_executor.py:_run_stage_0a) writes docs/idea-refined.md, docs/product-plan.md, docs/domain-analysis.md, discovery-panel.json and discovery-questions.json, but NEVER writes its canonical stage artifact artifacts/0a/discovery-output.md. Only core/pipeline_tailoring.py:45 READS it.

Compounding cause: _clear_stale_stage_artifacts (core/pipeline_executor.py:848, BI-0088) deletes stale '<agent>-output.md' on rerun -> the old discovery-output.md is removed and never regenerated, leaving an orphan artifacts/0a/discovery-output.xlsx with no .md.

FIX: 0a writes artifacts/0a/discovery-output.md (the discovery output: ALL panel Q&A + recommendations + synthesis (per-project count, config-driven by max_questions_per_agent x agents)) as the canonical artifact and lets artifact_formats derive .html/.xlsx from it. Regenerate from the EXISTING panel/docs where present (no need to re-ask the 90 questions). Ensure the cleanup only removes what the stage will rewrite.

HARDENING (all augmentation stages): the artifact is now written as soon as the answers are final (before synthesis), then refreshed with the refined text, so a later synthesis/step failure cannot lose it (rerun cleanup deletes the previous -output.md first). _run_design_augmentations now attributes failures per stage ([Design:<stage>]). Verified: artifact survives a simulated synthesis failure.

dashboard_impact.reason: Existing artifact view already lists stage artifacts; the fix is backend-only (no new UI).

_note: 0a now writes artifacts/0a/discovery-output.md (canonical) + derives .html/.xlsx via artifact_formats; config/artifact-formats.json adds discovery -> md/html/xlsx. Regenerated for ProductForge-Dashboard (md 152KB, html 164KB, xlsx 5.5KB).
